content_data.meeting_title: Predictive Maintenance Pilot - Phase 1 Review & Next Steps
agenda_items: Evaluation of potential ROI and scalability for broader European rollout
Analysis of model accuracy and data quality issues identified
Defining scope and objectives for Phase 2
Discussion on integration challenges with existing MES/ERP systems
Review of Phase 1 Predictive Maintenance Pilot results (Manufacturing Line 3)
key_decisions: Prioritize data cleansing and standardization efforts before Phase 2 model deployment.
Form a dedicated cross-functional task force to address MES/ERP integration roadblocks.
Initiate a detailed cost-benefit analysis for a full-scale European implementation.
Proceed with Phase 2, focusing on expanding to two additional manufacturing lines within a European facility.
action_items: Prepare a detailed Phase 1 performance report for executive review by next week (Consultant Team).
Research potential third-party data visualization tools to enhance reporting capabilities (Dr. Kai Chen).
Draft a proposal outlining the scope, resources, and timeline for Phase 2 (Consultant Team lead).
Circulate minutes and key decisions to all attendees within 24 hours (Meeting Coordinator).
Schedule a workshop with IT and Operations to define data integration requirements for Phase 2 (Ana Rodriguez).
